polypop.isConnected.description: Checks whether PolyPop is connected to Cuebot right now (at least one Cuebot plugin in PolyPop).
polypop.isConnected.returns: true while at least one PolyPop plugin is connected, otherwise false.

polypop.triggerAlert.description: Sets off a WebSocket Alert in PolyPop and hands it some words to show. Fails with an error when PolyPop is not connected.

parameters.alertName: The alert's name as set in PolyPop, like "Follow". Needed.
parameters.variables: Optional. Words for the alert to use, like {"user": "CoolViewer"}. Every value is sent as text.

polypop.triggerAlert.returns: How many PolyPop plugins got the alert.
